column1: # N-labels: N1 = g/9 joined by a horizontal stroke to a rho/p-like sign ("9-ρ"), one unit (L01, L02, L07). N2 = g/9 followed by "=" (two short bars), sometimes a small cross above ("9="; L03, L13). N3 = T with a crossbar plus a 7-like leg/hook at right ("Ŧ7", "Tn"; L08, L11, L14). N4 = a free-standing 7-like hook before b (L08 end; may be part of h7). N5 = loop/bowl with a long ascender-descender curving back, like ϑ or ʃ (distinct from the 5-shaped S and from the ∂-shaped d; frequent). N6 unused. N7 = g/9 followed by a 7-like hook ("97", "gr"), not crossed (L05, L08, L12, L14, L16). N8 = f-like hook with a vertical stroke through it ("+f", L16). N9 = v/w-shaped sign with a loop on its right stroke, last sign of L16. Notes: "coo" in L12 reads "doo" and in L13 "boo" (lead letter uncertain). dt in L08/L15 carries dots by its cross (could be d + ÷). The final ? of L04 is a hatched/struck scribble ending in "=", possibly a cancellation.
